status: Primary-source research, strict editorial/key review, content/source/audio/preservation/browser/build and production offline gates passed; native review pending.
method: Read the full relevant teaching sections on the publishers’ own Bunpro and Maggie Sensei pages. Original conversations, diary passages and examples. Earlier publisher-labelled forms are reviewed in advanced descriptions, not declared official N2 assignments.

points.formation: Established adjective stems + げ; げな noun / げに verb.
points.teachingChoice: A stern look, apparent enjoyment and a possible interpretation of a joke; the presenter himself explains the missing glasses.
points.sourceCaution: The sources restrict free attachment. Usually observed emotions are described; this is not an absolute prohibition on other referents or proof of inner feelings. Bunpro labels N2.

points.form: Resemblance or a recurring trait: っぽい
points.teachingChoice: Childish joke and forgetful habits, plus a formation-constrained watery-soup negative.
points.sourceCaution: Meaning and compatibility depend on the word. Colour may be neutral; resembling something does not universally rule out actually being it. Both publishers label N3.

points.formation: ます-stem + やすい; い-adjective conjugation.
points.teachingChoice: Readable handwriting, approachability and susceptibility to tension remain distinct activities or judgments.
points.sourceCaution: Not cheapness 安い; no blanket claim that を cannot occur in a longer ease sentence. Earlier N4-labelled construction in this unit.

points.formation: ます-stem/established noun + がち; がちな/の before noun.
points.teachingChoice: Two stated late returns support a recent pattern. A stem-attachment question fixes the target form.
points.sourceCaution: Not always, a diagnosis or an exclusively non-volitional suffix. The Maggie comments explicitly allow volitional and non-volitional verbs. Publisher N3 labels.

points.formation: ます-stem/established noun + 気味; 気味だ/です and 気味の noun.
points.teachingChoice: Kenta reports this week’s sleep shortage; no inferred fever. Exact suffix reading is taught.
points.sourceCaution: Not restricted to health or exclusively the speaker; compatibility matters. Trait, recurrence and current condition can overlap, so no unqualified multiple-choice contrast. Publisher N3 labels.

editorialReview.sceneChoice: A workshop impression and a timely library return. Descriptive headwords are supplementary study rather than a conversation quota; no personality diagnosis or unrelated formal vocabulary.
editorialReview.remaining: Whole N2 core review after unit 16 and independent native sentence/listening review.
